title: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Shatters Records with Estimated $2.36 Billion Opening Day
snippet: Rockstar Games' long-awaited 'Grand Theft Auto VI' has finally arrived, pulling in an estimated $2.36 billion on day one and dominating social media as millions of gamers jump into the action.
content:
After years of intense anticipation, Grand Theft Auto VI has officially arrived, triggering a massive wave of excitement across the gaming world and setting what could be unprecedented industry benchmarks. According to initial estimates from market research firm Sensor Tower, the blockbuster title generated a staggering $2.36 billion in pre-orders and opening-day sales, moving approximately 24.5 million copies following its Thursday launch.

Heavy Downloads and Network Strain

Getting ready for launch day required some serious digital housekeeping for players. The game takes up a whopping 212GB of storage space on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. The sudden influx of eager players downloading the massive file briefly caused PlayStation's network to crash on Wednesday afternoon, though connection issues were quickly resolved ahead of the full release window.

A Cultural Event Takes Over

Priced at $79.99 for the standard edition and $99.99 for the ultimate package, the game is already dominating live streams on Twitch and driving viral trends across social media. Publisher Take-Two Interactive and developer Rockstar Games have not yet released finalized sales metrics, but executives called the initial consumer demand "unprecedented."

With millions of fans expected to skip work and school to explore the new title, even brand partners are leaning into the hype. Xbox famously circulated a satirical doctor's excuse note signed by DJ Khaled, offering fans a lighthearted excuse to call out sick and play all weekend long.
